title: JSONiq
description: Settings of the JSONiq language server, which provides completions, diagnostics and hover documentation. Changing them restarts the language server.

rumbleEnabled.title: RumbleDB features
rumbleEnabled.description: Complete the fields of objects and infer types with RumbleDB. Requires Java 17 or later; RumbleDB is downloaded on first use.

lakehouseFormats.title: Lakehouse formats
lakehouseFormats.description: Table formats that RumbleDB can read. They are off by default, because enabling one changes how Spark runs every query.

delta.title: Delta Lake
delta.description: Delta Lake, for delta-file() and table().

sparkConf.title: Spark properties
sparkConf.description: Extra Spark properties for RumbleDB, such as "spark.sql.shuffle.partitions": 8. Keys must start with "spark.". They override the properties of the lakehouse formats, except spark.sql.extensions: extensions listed there are added, not replaced.
